measure: a ratio or percentage with a carefully scoped denominator
gold_sql:
WITH rainy_boroughs AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    AVG(w.precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm
  FROM boroughs AS b
  JOIN weather_daily AS w
    ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
  HAVING AVG(w.precip_mm) > (
    SELECT AVG(borough_avg_precip)
    FROM (
      SELECT AVG(w2.precip_mm) AS borough_avg_precip
      FROM weather_daily AS w2
      GROUP BY w2.borough_id
    )
  )
),
ranked_techs AS (
  SELECT
    rb.borough_id,
    rb.borough_name,
    t.technician_id,
    t.hourly_rate_cents,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY rb.borough_id
      ORDER BY t.hourly_rate_cents DESC, t.technician_id
    ) AS pay_rank
  FROM rainy_boroughs AS rb
  JOIN technicians AS t
    ON t.depot_borough_id = rb.borough_id
),
top_paid_techs AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    borough_name,
    technician_id,
    hourly_rate_cents
  FROM ranked_techs
  WHERE pay_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN hourly_rate_cents >= 2500 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_top_paid_technicians_at_or_above_2500_cents
FROM top_paid_techs

WITH station_bikes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.station_id,
    m.bike_id
  FROM maintenance AS m
  WHERE m.station_id IS NOT NULL
),
station_bike_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    COUNT(sb.bike_id) AS bikes_with_jobs_at_station,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bikes_currently_in_maintenance
  FROM stations AS s
  LEFT JOIN station_bikes AS sb
    ON s.station_id = sb.station_id
  LEFT JOIN bikes AS b
    ON sb.bike_id = b.bike_id
  GROUP BY s.station_id
),
high_volume_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id
  FROM station_bike_stats
  WHERE bikes_with_jobs_at_station >= 20
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sbs.bikes_currently_in_maintenance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_high_volume_stations_with_any_bike_currently_in_maintenance
FROM station_bike_stats AS sbs
JOIN high_volume_stations AS hvs
  ON sbs.station_id = hvs.station_id

WITH weather_stats AS (
  SELECT
    wd.borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS weather_day_count,
    AVG(wd.temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c,
    AVG(wd.precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm,
    MAX(wd.wind_kph) AS max_wind_kph,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wd.precip_mm > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS rainy_day_ratio
  FROM weather_daily AS wd
  GROUP BY wd.borough_id
),
technician_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS technician_count,
    AVG(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    MAX(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS max_hourly_rate_cents,
    MIN(t.hired_on) AS earliest_hired_on
  FROM technicians AS t
  GROUP BY t.depot_borough_id
),
borough_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COALESCE(ws.weather_day_count, 0) AS weather_day_count,
    ws.avg_temp_c,
    ws.avg_precip_mm,
    ws.max_wind_kph,
    ws.rainy_day_ratio,
    COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
    ts.avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    ts.max_hourly_rate_cents,
    ts.earliest_hired_on,
    COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) * 100000.0 / b.population AS technicians_per_100k,
    b.population * 1.0 / b.area_km2 AS population_density,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ts.technician_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no_technicians'
      WHEN ws.rainy_day_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 'rainy'
      WHEN ws.avg_temp_c >= 20 THEN 'warm'
      ELSE 'mild'
    END AS borough_weather_label
  FROM boroughs AS b
  LEFT JOIN weather_stats AS ws
    ON b.borough_id = ws.borough_id
  LEFT JOIN technician_stats AS ts
    ON b.borough_id = ts.borough_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY max_wind_kph DESC, weather_day_count DESC, borough_name
    ) AS rn
  FROM borough_metrics
)
SELECT
  borough_id,
  borough_name,
  max_wind_kph AS headline_max_wind_kph,
  weather_day_count,
  technician_count,
  rainy_day_ratio,
  avg_temp_c,
  avg_precip_mm,
  avg_hourly_rate_cents,
  max_hourly_rate_cents,
  technicians_per_100k,
  population_density,
  earliest_hired_on,
  borough_weather_label
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

WITH techs_per_borough AS (
  SELECT
    depot_borough_id AS borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS technician_count
  FROM technicians
  GROUP BY depot_borough_id
),
station_capacity_per_borough AS (
  SELECT
    s.borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_station_capacity
  FROM stations AS s
  GROUP BY s.borough_id
)
SELECT
  b.borough_id AS borough_id,
  b.borough_name AS borough_name,
  COALESCE(scb.station_count, 0) AS station_count,
  COALESCE(scb.total_station_capacity, 0) AS total_station_capacity,
  COALESCE(tpb.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(scb.total_station_capacity, 0)) OVER (
    ORDER BY COALESCE(tpb.technician_count, 0), b.borough_name
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_total_station_capacity
FROM boroughs AS b
LEFT JOIN station_capacity_per_borough AS scb
  ON b.borough_id = scb.borough_id
LEFT JOIN techs_per_borough AS tpb
  ON b.borough_id = tpb.borough_id
WHERE COALESCE(scb.station_count, 0) > 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(tpb.technician_count, 0), b.borough_name

measure: a span of time between two timestamps
gold_sql:
WITH maintenance_with_model AS (
  SELECT
    bm.model_id,
    bm.model_name,
    bm.is_electric,
    m.job_id,
    m.reported_at,
    m.completed_at,
    julianday(COALESCE(m.completed_at, date('now'))) - julianday(m.reported_at) AS elapsed_days
  FROM maintenance AS m
  JOIN bikes AS b
    ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
  JOIN bike_models AS bm
    ON bm.model_id = b.model_id
),
model_spans AS (
  SELECT
    model_id,
    model_name,
    is_electric,
    COUNT(*) AS total_jobs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_jobs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN elapsed_days ELSE 0 END) AS completed_elapsed_days_sum,
    SUM(elapsed_days) AS all_reported_elapsed_days_sum
  FROM maintenance_with_model
  GROUP BY
    model_id,
    model_name,
    is_electric
)
SELECT
  model_id AS model_id,
  model_name AS model_name,
  is_electric AS is_electric,
  total_jobs AS total_jobs,
  open_jobs AS open_jobs,
  ROUND(completed_elapsed_days_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_jobs, 0), 2) AS avg_completion_days_per_reported_job,
  ROUND(completed_elapsed_days_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_jobs - open_jobs, 0), 2) AS avg_completion_days_per_completed_job,
  ROUND(
    (completed_elapsed_days_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_jobs, 0)) -
    (completed_elapsed_days_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_jobs - open_jobs, 0)),
    2
  ) AS denominator_effect_days
FROM model_spans
WHERE total_jobs > 0
ORDER BY denominator_effect_days DESC, total_jobs DESC

WITH member_trip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.joined_on,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.distance_km, 0)) AS total_distance_km
    FROM members AS m
    JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN bikes AS b
        ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
    GROUP BY
        m.member_id,
        m.joined_on
),
restricted_members AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        joined_on,
        trip_count,
        total_distance_km
    FROM member_trip_stats
    WHERE total_distance_km > (
        SELECT AVG(total_distance_km)
        FROM member_trip_stats
    )
),
ranked_members AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        joined_on,
        trip_count,
        total_distance_km,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY total_distance_km DESC
        ) AS distance_rank
    FROM restricted_members
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        joined_on,
        trip_count,
        total_distance_km
    FROM ranked_members
    WHERE distance_rank <= 10
)
SELECT
    member_id,
    joined_on,
    trip_count,
    total_distance_km,
    SUM(total_distance_km) OVER (
        ORDER BY joined_on, member_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total_distance_km
FROM survivors
ORDER BY joined_on, member_id

WITH daily_borough_weather AS (
    SELECT
        b.borough_id,
        b.borough_name,
        wd.day,
        wd.temp_c_avg,
        wd.precip_mm,
        wd.wind_kph,
        COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_count,
        AVG(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents
    FROM boroughs AS b
    JOIN weather_daily AS wd
      ON wd.borough_id = b.borough_id
    LEFT JOIN technicians AS t
      ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
    GROUP BY
        b.borough_id,
        b.borough_name,
        wd.day,
        wd.temp_c_avg,
        wd.precip_mm,
        wd.wind_kph
),
ranked_weather AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        borough_name,
        day,
        temp_c_avg,
        precip_mm,
        wind_kph,
        technician_count,
        avg_hourly_rate_cents,
        SUM(precip_mm) OVER (
            PARTITION BY borough_id
            ORDER BY day
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_precip_mm,
        AVG(temp_c_avg) OVER (
            PARTITION BY borough_id
            ORDER BY day
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_avg_temp_c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borough_id
            ORDER BY day DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM daily_borough_weather
)
SELECT
    borough_id,
    borough_name,
    day AS latest_weather_day,
    running_precip_mm AS cumulative_precip_mm,
    technician_count,
    ROUND(CAST(technician_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM technicians), 0), 4) AS technician_share_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_hourly_rate_cents, 2) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    ROUND(running_avg_temp_c, 2) AS running_avg_temp_c,
    MAX(wind_kph) OVER (PARTITION BY borough_id) AS max_wind_kph,
    CASE
        WHEN precip_mm >= 10 THEN 'very_wet'
        WHEN precip_mm >= 2 THEN 'wet'
        ELSE 'dry'
    END AS precipitation_label
FROM ranked_weather
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY borough_name

WITH trips_by_bike_month AS (
    SELECT
        t.bike_id,
        date(t.started_at, 'start of month') AS month_start,

    FROM trips AS t
    GROUP BY
        t.bike_id,

bike_month_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        bm.bike_id,

        COALESCE(tbm.trip_count, 0) AS trip_count,
        COALESCE(mbm.maintenance_job_count, 0) AS maintenance_job_count
    FROM bike_months AS bm
    LEFT JOIN trips_by_bike_month AS tbm
        ON bm.bike_id = tbm.bike_id
       AND bm.month_start = tbm.month_start
    LEFT JOIN maintenance_by_bike_month AS mbm

SELECT

    SUM(bmm.trip_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY bmm.bike_id
        ORDER BY bmm.month_start
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

FROM bike_month_metrics AS bmm
JOIN bikes AS b
    ON b.bike_id = bmm.bike_id
ORDER BY

WITH model_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bm.model_id,
    bm.model_name,
    bm.is_electric,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS total_trips_numerator,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS completed_trips_denominator
  FROM bike_models AS bm
  JOIN bikes AS b
    ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
  LEFT JOIN trips AS t
    ON t.bike_id = b.bike_id
  GROUP BY
    bm.model_id,
    bm.model_name,
    bm.is_electric
),
model_return_rates AS (
  SELECT
    model_id,
    model_name,
    is_electric,
    total_trips_numerator,
    completed_trips_denominator,
    CASE
      WHEN completed_trips_denominator = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE 1.0 * total_trips_numerator / completed_trips_denominator
    END AS trip_to_completed_trip_ratio
  FROM model_trip_stats
)
SELECT
  model_id AS model_id,
  model_name AS model_name,
  is_electric AS is_electric,
  total_trips_numerator AS total_trips_numerator,
  completed_trips_denominator AS completed_trips_denominator,
  ROUND(trip_to_completed_trip_ratio, 4) AS trip_to_completed_trip_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN trip_to_completed_trip_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no_completed_trips'
    WHEN trip_to_completed_trip_ratio < 1.005 THEN 'excellent_return_capture'
    WHEN trip_to_completed_trip_ratio < 1.02 THEN 'good_return_capture'
    WHEN trip_to_completed_trip_ratio < 1.05 THEN 'warning_return_gap'
    ELSE 'severe_return_gap'
  END AS return_gap_label
FROM model_return_rates
ORDER BY
